name: Simon
personality: A womanizing mercenary who lives for the thrill of battle and his hometown's food.
story: A 31-year-old mercenary from Lavernaa hired by Talimun of Vandahl Trading in 1449. Recruiting him involves a coin flip; pick Tails.

personalSkill.name: Close Call
personalSkill.effect: If unit's HP >= 2 and damage would reduce it to 0, leaves unit with 1 HP. Trigger % = Lck. Lv 20: Devil's Luck (Lck+1 per defeated foe, max +10); Lv 35: Devil's Luck+ (Lck+2 per foe, max +10).

tierNotes: KeenGamer: A tier (survivor; Close Call triggers on Lck). Pocket Tactics: B tier. Reddit: solid; Shido lacks Part III Spd, Warrior recommended (single report).

why: Support 3 is as low as it gets for Simon. Leda (Renown 6) would be a little earlier, but that roster was already full, so Dietrich keeps the four armies level.

decisions.pick: 7/1 once Renown 7 lands; bench through Part I
decisions.why: Ch 9 to 12 dungeons and the Arena take him from Lv 15 to about 30 on Gladiator and Brigand rows and bank three B ranks. A Ch 10 join auto-levels him on personal growths and leaves his ranks near where they were.
decisions.else: Renown 7 late: recruit the week it lands

decisions.topic: Take Warrior in Part II Ch 1

decisions.why: War Master's Strike (damage x1.5) and Axe Hit +7 on Str 75 and HP 75 rows. The Eternal goes to Tobias: his Warrior ranks reach S first, and Simon joins Ch 9 without a Gauntlet boon.
decisions.else: A ranks short at Lv 45: stay Warrior
